messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 triggered: prom-scrape-failures in prod (incident 2008501234) - some Prometheus targets failing to scrape, scrape_error rate spike. Pager: @oncall-1, escalation to @platform-lead if not acknowledged in 5m

oncall-1: acked. looking now. can someone paste the affected job names?

sam: seeing lots of `connection refused` from `prometheus-scrape-redwood-metrics` pods hitting `metrics-exporter-backend:9100`. Also `kube-state-metrics` scrape failing in eu-west1.

maria: prometheus graph: targets down from ~650 -> 520. error buckets show `dial tcp` and `i/o timeout`.

jen: logs from scrape worker: ```
level=error ts=2026-03-14T14:12:03Z msg="scrape failed" job=redwood-metrics target=10.12.7.8:9100 err="dial tcp 10.12.7.8:9100: connect: connection refused"
```

oncall-1: looks like a networking or node-level issue? checking CNI events and kubelet logs for the nodes hosting exporter pods.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: Incident escalated to @platform-lead (30s elapsed)

platform-lead: i'm online. quick check: GCE autoscaler pushed a maintenance window earlier in eu-west1, some nodes were recycled. kubelet churn could explain exporter flaps. can we confirm node readiness?

sam: `kubectl get nodes` shows 3 NotReady in eu-west1. kubelet logs show repeated TLS handshake errors to the control plane. our control-plane-control-plane metrics show high apiserver latencies ~1.2s.

maria: also seeing Fluentd/vector backlog increasing on logging side: log_ingest_backlog ~ 120k events across partitions. dashboards staling. that might cause customer-facing logs to be delayed.

oncall-1: immediate plan: 1) cordon + drain any nodes in `maintenance` state? 2) restart `prometheus-scrape` deployment to reschedule scrapers off bad nodes 3) scale Vector/Fluentd ingestion to absorb backlog. starting step 2 now.

jen: double-check runbook for `prometheus-scrape-failure` (runbook/ref: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/prom-scrape). runbook suggests `kubectl rollout restart deploy/prometheus-scrape --namespace monitoring` and bump replicas.

oncall-1: running: ```sh
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy/prometheus-scrape
kubectl -n monitoring scale deploy/prometheus-scrape --replicas=5
```

sam: rollout started. new pods landing on healthy nodes. initial target count back up +30 within 90s.

maria: scaling vector: ```sh
kubectl -n logging scale deploy/vector-ingest --replicas=6
```
vector replicas now 6, backlog draining rate increased from ~300/s -> ~1.2k/s. projected drain ~2m.

support-lead: heads-up: several customers reported alerts that dashboards were missing recent metrics (support ticket #3421, #3423). flagging for post-incident comms.

oncall-1: monitoring: alert noise decreased. Prom target count back to 648/650 within 3m. log backlog down to 18k. still some nodes NotReady but scrapers rescheduled.

platform-lead: good. can we confirm no data loss? Vector preserves local disk; we should be able to forward without drops. any exporter's persistent queues overflowed?

maria: no disk full warnings. vector stats show no drops, only increased queue depth. prometheus missed samples window is small; we might have gaps ~1-2 minutes for some targets but no long-term loss.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by @oncall-1 and @platform-lead.

jen: running a quick audit for other affected regions: APAC and US regions look healthy. eu-west1 was the primary impact.

oncall-1: performing customer impact assessment: - dashboards: delayed data for 10-15m window during node churn - alerts: some threshold-based alerts may have fired during gap, false positives possible - logs: delayed by up to ~8-10 minutes for a subset of shards; no evidence of dropped messages

support-lead: I'll open a status update to customers with the summary and ETA on full backlog drain. drafting now.

sam: follow-up action items: 1) investigate root cause of TLS handshake errors to apiserver during maintenance 2) improve graceful-drain on node autoscaler 3) add runbook bullet to auto-scale vector earlier when log_ingest_backlog >50k 4) add a scrapers healthcheck that avoids running on NotReady nodes 5) add dashboard for scrape target churn rate

platform-lead: agree. add a retrospective to incident board and assign owners. set ac: ensure no more than 1% of targets down during node maintenance.

oncall-1: handing off to @maria for next 30 minutes to watch backlog and confirm stability. summary: scrapers restarted + scaled, vector scaled, backlog dropping, customer-facing impact limited to short windows.

maria: ack. i'm on watch. will escalate if backlog stops dropping or if target count dips again.

incident-bot: Note: incident 2008501234 moved to "monitoring". Please add postmortem within 72h.

support-lead: customer status posted: "We experienced temporary metric gaps and log delivery delays in eu-west1 due to node maintenance; services are stable and data backlog is draining. A full postmortem will follow." :white_check_mark: 

oncall-1: closing page for now. thanks everyone. :heart:
